title: D2P Pattern Piece
description: A pattern piece with its contours, edges and piece-level elements (design decision ADR-007). A piece has exactly one connected outer boundary; separate cut islands are separate pieces. Element identity is independent of seam allowance, SVG/PDF object IDs, coordinates and sewing order.

piece.title: Piece
piece.description: A pattern piece. 'contours' contains exactly one contour with role 'outer' (schema-enforced) and any number of holes.

id.description: Stable element ID of the piece.

contours.description: The piece's contours: exactly one with role 'outer', optionally holes.

notches.description: Notches of the piece. Omitted when there are none.

grainlines.description: Grainlines of the piece. Omitted when there are none.

folds.description: Fold lines of the piece. Omitted when there are none.

cutInstruction.description: How the piece is cut. Absent means one implicit cut instance whose cutInstanceKey is the piece id, not mirrored.

seamAllowance.description: Seam allowance of the piece. Absent means no seam allowance is defined. Seam allowance is derived geometry and never part of seam identity.

extensions.description: Optional namespaced extension blocks (§1.7 of the schema catalog).

contour.title: Contour
contour.description: A closed chain of edges. The chain MUST close via shared point features (D2P-SEM-010); a coincident constraint does not count.

id.description: Stable element ID of the contour.

role.description: Whether this contour is the piece's outer boundary or a hole.

extensions.description: Optional namespaced extension blocks (§1.7 of the schema catalog).

edge.title: Edge
edge.description: One edge of a contour, backed by a curve feature. The edge direction is the curve direction, flipped if 'reversed'. Two edges of the same piece MUST NOT reference the same curve (D2P-SEM-013).

id.description: Stable element ID of the edge.

curveFeatureId.description: Element ID of the curve backing this edge feature in the same pattern.

reversed.description: True if the edge runs against the curve direction (start and end swapped).

extensions.description: Optional namespaced extension blocks (§1.7 of the schema catalog).

notch.title: Notch
notch.description: A notch (balance mark) on an edge.

id.description: Stable element ID of the notch.

edgeId.description: Element ID of the edge carrying the notch.

position.description: Position as normalized arc length in [0, 1] along the edge direction.

marks.description: Number of notch marks (1 to 3), used to tell matching notches apart.

extensions.description: Optional namespaced extension blocks (§1.7 of the schema catalog).

grainline.title: Grainline
grainline.description: A grainline running from a start point feature to an end point feature.

id.description: Stable element ID of the grainline.

startFeatureId.description: Element ID of the start point feature in the same pattern.

endFeatureId.description: Element ID of the end point feature in the same pattern.

extensions.description: Optional namespaced extension blocks (§1.7 of the schema catalog).

fold.title: Fold
fold.description: A fold line; the referenced edge is the fold line.

id.description: Stable element ID of the fold.

edgeId.description: Element ID of the edge that is the fold line.

extensions.description: Optional namespaced extension blocks (§1.7 of the schema catalog).

cutInstruction.title: Cut instruction
cutInstruction.description: How many instances of the piece are cut, and from which material role. The fabric layer/face is not modelled in this release.

instances.description: Cut instances of the piece. Keys are unique within the piece (D2P-REF-005).

materialRole.description: Material role the piece is cut from.

cutInstance.title: Cut instance
cutInstance.description: One physical instance of a piece produced by cutting.

cutInstanceKey.description: Key of the cut instance, referenced by seam interfaces and layer orders.

mirrored.description: True if this instance is cut mirrored.

seamAllowance.title: Seam allowance
seamAllowance.description: Seam allowance of a piece: a default width plus optional per-edge overrides. The offset geometry is an evaluator capability.

default.description: Expression wrapper; the expression MUST have dimension length (checked at semantic level, D2P-SEM-002).

edges.description: Per-edge overrides of the default width. Omitted when there are none.

edgeSeamAllowance.title: Edge seam allowance
edgeSeamAllowance.description: Seam allowance width for one edge, overriding the piece default.

expr.description: Seam allowance width; the expression MUST have dimension length.
